verified: Arriva's own announcement states the North-West North Holland bus contract is worth about €2 billion and runs 13 years from July 2028, with a two-year option; the fleet will be 100% electric and number more than 200 buses, which Arriva calls its largest-ever bus contract (Arriva; also reported by Sustainable Bus and Bus News).
unconfirmed: the split between new and existing vehicles, which manufacturers will supply the buses, and how much of the €2 billion covers vehicles versus operations are not specified; the initial electrive report gave no start date or operator-level detail, so those figures rest on Arriva's release and the trade press rather than an independent test or regulatory filing.

verified: Arriva 官方新闻稿以及 Sustainable Bus、Bus News 的报道均确认，Arriva 赢得荷兰北荷兰省西北部为期 13 年的公交特许经营合同（另有两年续约选项），合同价值约 20 亿欧元，是 Arriva 历史上最大的巴士合同；服务将于 2028 年 7 月启动，届时投入超过 200 辆巴士组成的 100% 纯电车队，并扩充线路、提高班次密度、增加接驳。
unconfirmed: 20 亿欧元中车辆采购与运营各占多少、其中新购电动巴士有多少辆（“超过 200 辆”包含现有车辆与新增车辆）、电动巴士由哪家厂商供应，目前均无披露；合同是否已完成正式签署，也只有 Arriva 一方的说法。

titles.en: Arriva wins €2bn North Holland contract with 200+ electric buses
titles.zh: Arriva 获荷兰北荷兰省约 20 亿欧元电动巴士合同
